svg.title: The eight chapters and their recorded uses of one another
svg.desc: Eight chapters on a ring around the grammar, sized by their results (The root 86, The map 94, Knowing and testing 110, Life and evolution 46, Collectives and selection 74, The classical texts 16, Significance and alignment 82, Method and the formal core 21); 497 formal-reuse uses between chapters, 17 pairs with at least 10 drawn, 212 of the uses run backward (the chapters are numbered for reading, not as an order of proof); under the standings, the five shared laws with the central rows on each and those reaching the grammar (Closure 42 rows, 42 reach; Balance 54 rows, 16 reach, represented, not derived; Finite runs 14 rows, 14 reach; Lumping 2 rows, 1 reach; Widening 8 rows, 1 reach); the continuation condition and C come into chapter 7 as premises, each a hypothesis where used, neither asserted; T1 to T8 at their homes, coloured by test outcome.
